review_burden.note: No absolute ceiling is declared because no measured baseline of operator minutes exists. Inventing one would either pass vacuously or fail on day one: 832 of 1174 historic song sections and 120 of 435 sermon sections are currently flagged. A candidate is therefore judged against the incumbent on the same detector-negative sample, and an absolute ceiling is added once operator minutes have been measured rather than guessed.

false_positive.note: Declared before detectors:evaluate existed and before any candidate was scored. Mirrors the recall declaration: a detector passes only when the upper bound of its false-positive rate over adjudicated clean cases is at or below its severity's ceiling. A signal that fired without holding still counts, because it still costs review. Provisional clean cases (re-decode, transcript reading, derived comparison) are reported but never enter the rate.

regression.prevented_requires: re-processing evidence; recorded output alone cannot show prevention, so a fixed-at-source class is unassessable here, never a pass
